parameters.content:
## Google Cloud Inventory & IAM Audit

**Full setup guide:** [Read the complete documentation](https://github.com/paoloronco/n8n-templates/blob/main/workflows/google-cloud-inventory/V3/SETUP.md)

### How it works
Run manually or daily at 03:15 in the workflow timezone. Discover resources, enabled APIs and visible IAM policies across configured projects. BigQuery stores complete snapshots, findings and change history; only completed scans become comparison baselines.

Eight Sheets tabs preserve review decisions: Dashboard, Inventory, Findings, Changes, Scans, Enabled APIs, Technical resources and Coverage. HTML/CSV exports and optional email complete delivery. Email reports substantive resource additions/removals; routine lifecycle records and confirmed system-managed key rotations are suppressed. Unknown key metadata stays visible. Coverage depends on API permissions and visibility.

### Setup
1. Enable the required Google APIs. Bind credentials to all Google HTTP nodes with inventory/IAM read, BigQuery job/dataset and Sheets access.
2. In **Configuration**, set project scopes, billing/quota project, dataset, location and sheetId. Review limits and governance rules.
3. [Open the Sheets dashboard/model](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/16uTQRgZSTN2GN2nE2giTPu2ZyfWONfvt5m5gkOIOgeY/copy), create your copy and grant the Sheets identity Editor access. Follow the setup guide for worksheets and headers.
4. Configure emailTo, emailFrom and SMTP when using sendEmail. Set n8nBaseUrl in **Configuration**; review timezone and Error Workflow in Settings.
5. Run a baseline and comparison manually; verify BigQuery, Sheets and exports before enabling the schedule. BigQuery usage may incur charges.

### Customization
Adjust requiredLabels, allowedLocations, retention and limits. Preserve sheet headers, hidden identifiers and review columns.

## 01 · Configure and track runs

Set project scopes, destinations and limits before discovery. The run registry tracks scan status independently from delivery, so failed or incomplete scans cannot silently become successful baselines.

## 02 · Discover and assess

Collect resources, enabled APIs and visible IAM policies. Native API requests enrich metadata beyond Cloud Asset Inventory. Check public access, broad roles, labels and locations; missing permissions reduce coverage and are reported explicitly.

## 03 · Persist and compare snapshots

Write bounded batches, then compare complete snapshots in BigQuery. The first scan establishes a baseline; later scans retain additions, modifications and removals. Setup, batch and audit jobs return through the shared worker.

## 04 · Review and deliver results

Update eight Sheets tabs while preserving review checkboxes and notes by stable identifiers. Email includes only substantive resource additions/removals. Download HTML and CSV from **Return report files**; keep sheet headers and hidden IDs intact.

## 05 · Record failures

Save failure details, then stop execution. Automatic runs can invoke the Error Workflow selected in Settings; inspect manual failures in Executions. Incomplete scans remain excluded from comparison baselines.
